lines.en: label futabafirstvisit:
I knock on Futaba's door and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Futaba 的门，等她来开。

lines.en: I figure with the amount of time I've spent at the library lately (As well as her not-so-hidden affinity for me), getting into her room shouldn't be all that hard.
lines.zh: 我想，凭我最近泡在图书馆的时间（再加上她对我那份藏都藏不住的好感），进她房间应该不会太难。

lines.en: But hey, she's a teenage girl and...girls can be territorial when it comes to their rooms or something. Probably.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，她是个十几岁的女孩，而……女孩对自己的房间大概会有领地意识什么的吧。大概。

lines.en: I don't really know. Ami isn't like that at all, but Ami is also proving to be a...special sort of case thus far.
lines.zh: 我也说不准。Ami 完全不是那样，不过 Ami 到目前为止也证明自己是个……特例。

lines.en: : Umm...hello?
lines.zh: : 嗯……您好？

lines.en: : Hey, Futaba, are you in there right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Futaba，你现在在里面吗？

lines.en: : Sensei? I'm sorry, I had no idea you were coming. Is something wrong?
lines.zh: : Sensei？抱歉，我不知道您要来。出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : Nope. Just dropping by to see how you’re doing. Mind coming out for a second?
lines.zh: : 没有。就是顺路过来看看你怎么样。能出来一下吗？

lines.en: : Of course! I'll be right out!
lines.zh: : 当然！我马上出来！

lines.en: I take a step back and wait for Futaba to- oh. Nevermind. She's already here.
lines.zh: 我后退一步，等着 Futaba——哦。算了。她已经在这儿了。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux1
: Umm...hi. Is there...something I can do for you?
lines.zh: : 嗯……您好。请问……有什么我能为您做的吗？

lines.en: : Yes, actually. Can I borrow 1000 yen?
lines.zh: : 还真有。能借我 1000 日元吗？

lines.en: : I...suppose. But can I...ask why you need to borrow money from me?
lines.zh: : 我……可以吧。不过我能……问问您为什么要找我借钱吗？

lines.en: : Futaba, no. Don't just agree to lending me money like that. I was only messing around.
lines.zh: : Futaba，别。别这么随口就答应借钱给我。我只是开玩笑的。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux2
: H-How was I supposed to know that? You've never visited me in my room before. I thought this might be some sort of emergency.
lines.zh: : 我、我怎么知道啊？您以前从没来过我的房间。我还以为出了什么紧急状况。

lines.en: : The only emergency here is my boredom.
lines.zh: : 这里唯一的紧急情况就是我太无聊了。

lines.en: : Or something.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : Anyway, what are you up to?
lines.zh: : 总之，你在忙什么？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux3
: Just reading...like always.
lines.zh: : 就是看书……跟平常一样。

lines.en: : You're lucky you knocked at a good stopping point. Otherwise, I probably wouldn't have even answered...
lines.zh: : 您运气好，敲的时候正好告一段落。不然我大概连应都不会应……

lines.en: : You {i}did{/i} sound a little confused answering the door. Do you not normally get visitors or something?
lines.zh: : 你开门的时候听起来{i}是{/i}有点懵。平时没什么人来找你吗？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux4
: Not ones that knock, at least...Most people just walk in.
lines.zh: : 至少没有会敲门的……大多数人都是直接走进来。

lines.en: : Well, I'll make sure to follow proper protocol next time and just open the door without running it by you first.
lines.zh: : 那下次我一定遵守这里的规矩，先斩后奏，直接推门进去。

lines.en: : Please don't ever do that at any point ever. I would die.
lines.zh: : 求您这辈子都千万别那么做。我会死的。

lines.en: : I'm more than happy to invite you in so long as I...actually know you're coming and-
lines.zh: : 只要我……真的知道您要来，我非常乐意请您进来，不过——

lines.en: : Cool. Let me in, then.
lines.zh: : 好。那让我进去吧。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux2
: Right now? Are you serious?
lines.zh: : 就现在吗？您认真的？

lines.en: : Sure. It's my duty as your teacher to make sure your...dorm room is conducive to proper...educational...learning stuff?
lines.zh: : 当然。作为你的老师，我有责任确认你的……宿舍房间有利于正当的……教育……学习活动？

lines.en: : Does that sound like something a teacher would say?
lines.zh: : 这话听起来像老师会说的吗？

lines.en: : That doesn't sound like something {i}anyone{/i} would say...why are you acting so strangely all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 这话听起来不像{i}任何人{/i}会说的……您怎么突然变得这么奇怪？

lines.en: : Is wanting to be alone with you inside of your room really that strange?
lines.zh: : 想和你单独待在你的房间里，真的有那么奇怪吗？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux5
: Well...maybe {i}strange{/i} was the wrong word to use. It's just...entirely unexpected.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许「{i}奇怪{/i}」这个词用得不对。只是……完全出乎意料。

lines.en: : But I guess if it's just to...make sure my room is conducive to proper...educational...learning stuff...it's okay?
lines.zh: : 不过如果只是……确认我的房间有利于正当的……教育……学习活动……那应该没关系吧？

lines.en: : There's not really...much to show you, though...so I doubt you'll have any fun.
lines.zh: : 只是……其实也没什么可看的……所以我觉得您不会觉得有意思。

lines.en: : Just being with you is fun enough for me, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 光是和你在一起就够有意思了，Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux6
: Umm...this might be a bit of a silly question, but...this isn't some sort of prank, is it?
lines.zh: : 嗯……这可能是个有点蠢的问题，不过……这不是什么恶作剧吧？

lines.en: : Did...someone put you up to this? Or...is there some sort of catch I don't know about yet?...
lines.zh: : 是……有人让您这么做的吗？还是……有什么我还不知道的陷阱？……

lines.en: : No. Why would you even assume that?
lines.zh: : 没有。你怎么会这么想？

lines.en: : It's just that...this all seems a little too good to be true. That's all.
lines.zh: : 只是……这一切听起来好得有点不真实。仅此而已。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux7
: W-W-W-W-Which doesn't mean that I've actually ever thought about something like this happening, of course!
lines.zh: : 当、当、当然这不代表我真的想过这种事会发生！

lines.en: : I just mean that in a...hypothetical situation where...I {i}had{/i} been dreaming about something like that...{i}then{/i} this would be too good to be true.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，在一种……假设的情况下……假如我{i}曾经{/i}梦见过这种事……{i}那{/i}这就好得不像真的了。

lines.en: : But as it stands, it's just...it's just normal good.
lines.zh: : 但就目前而言，它只是……只是普普通通的好。

lines.en: : Futaba.
lines.zh: : Futaba。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux8
: Yes, I'm sorry. Please follow me in, Sensei...but again, don't expect too much...
lines.zh: : 是，抱歉。请进吧，Sensei……不过再说一次，别抱太大期望……

lines.en: scene black
scene futabafirstdormredux9
: So, umm, here we are...my completely unexciting bedroom...
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯，我们到了……我这个毫无亮点的卧室……

lines.en: : I'm going to go ahead and assume this the first time you’ve had a guy in your room?
lines.zh: : 我猜，这应该是你第一次带男生进房间吧？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux10
: The only other {i}guy{/i} I know is my dad, so...
lines.zh: : 我认识的其他{i}男生{/i}就只有我爸爸，所以……

lines.en: : There's no way that is the only other male you know.
lines.zh: : 你认识的其他男性不可能只有他一个。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux11
: Boys, umm...weren't really interested in me in middle school...so I mostly just...flew under the radar.
lines.zh: : 男生，嗯……初中的时候对我没什么兴趣……所以我基本……一直躲在雷达底下。

lines.en: : Way under the radar.
lines.zh: : 深深地躲在雷达底下。

lines.en: : And while I like attending an all-girls school for...completely unrelated reasons...it hasn’t really helped prepare me for situations like this...
lines.zh: : 虽然我很喜欢上女校——因为……完全无关的原因——但这也没能让我为这种情况做好准备……

lines.en: : No secret online boyfriends or anything either?
lines.zh: : 也没有什么偷偷交往的网友男朋友之类的？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux12
: Not that I'm aware of...
lines.zh: : 据我所知没有……

lines.en: : There was one...umm...person on a message board I used to visit, but...that was a...kind of...roleplaying thing, so...
lines.zh: : 倒是有一个……嗯……我以前常去的留言板上的人，不过……那算是……一种……角色扮演的东西，所以……

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux13
: W-Why am I even telling you about that when you...obviously don't want to hear any of it.
lines.zh: : 您……明显不想听这些，我为什么还要跟您说啊。

lines.en: : You’re just...here to look at the room...right, Sensei? For the...learning...education thing?
lines.zh: : 您只是……来看房间的……对吧，Sensei？为了那个……学习……教育的事？

lines.en: : You probably don't even know what roleplay {i}is{/i} and...uhh...
lines.zh: : 您大概连什么{i}是{/i}角色扮演都不知道，而且……呃……

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux14
: Can you please say something to prevent me from rambling and revealing any more embarrassing secrets?
lines.zh: : 您能不能说点什么，好让我别再喋喋不休地抖出更多丢人的秘密？

lines.en: : I guess, but I was kind of interested in hearing where that was going.
lines.zh: : 行吧，不过我其实还挺想听你接着说下去的。

lines.en: : I don't even know...how I would have started in explaining it, so...it's probably best if we just move on and forget any of the last two minutes ever happened.
lines.zh: : 我连……该怎么开口解释都不知道，所以……我们最好还是跳过，把这两分钟发生的事全忘了吧。

lines.en: I scan Futaba’s side of the room and I'm not able to really learn anything new about her other than that she's a bit neater and more organized than Rin.
lines.zh: 我扫了一遍 Futaba 那一半的房间，除了发现她比 Rin 爱整洁、更有条理之外，也没能了解到什么新东西。

lines.en: There’s a quote from Edgar Allan Poe on her dry erase board, which is...sort of surprising since she doesn't seem like the type to indulge in gothic poetry...
lines.zh: 她的白板上抄着一句爱伦·坡的话，这……有点意外，因为她看起来不像是会沉迷哥特诗的那种人……

lines.en: But I guess I don't really seem like that type of person either and I don't have any problems with him.
lines.zh: 不过我想，我看起来也不像那种人，而我跟他之间也没什么过节。

lines.en: Dying alone, drunk, and probably rabid is a pretty memorable way to go out, all things considered.
lines.zh: 孤独地、醉醺醺地、大概还带着狂犬病死掉，怎么说都是一种相当难忘的退场方式。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux12
: So, umm...this is where I do all of my school work and...all of my writing.
lines.zh: : 那个，嗯……我所有的功课和……所有的写作都是在这儿做的。

lines.en: : When I'm...actually able to get any writing done, that is. Being creative is...kind of really hard and I wish I was better at it.
lines.zh: : 在我……真的写得出来的时候。创作这种事……真的很难，我要是能做得更好就好了。

lines.en: : Well, have you started writing anything for me yet? Because practicing is pretty much the only way you're going to get any better.
lines.zh: : 那么，你已经开始为我写点什么了吗？毕竟练习基本上是你变好的唯一途径。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux10
: I have, but....it’s not very good.
lines.zh: : 写了，不过……写得不太好。

lines.en: : Can I see it? Or are you going to make me wait until it's more up to your standards?
lines.zh: : 能给我看看吗？还是你要让我等到它更符合你的标准为止？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux15
: I-Ignoring how low my standards are...please wait a little longer!
lines.zh: : 先、先别管我的标准有多低……请再等等！

lines.en: : I've...barely even started! I need more time to...build the world and...the characters and...
lines.zh: : 我……才刚开了个头！我还需要时间……去构建世界观、角色……

lines.en: : The plot...
lines.zh: : 还有剧情……

lines.en: : How much have you gotten done, exactly?
lines.zh: : 具体来说，你写了多少了？

lines.en: : The...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux16
: The title?...
: Wow.
: Being creative is...{i}really{/i} hard...
lines.zh: : 创作……{i}真的{/i}好难……

lines.en: : Hey, I told you before right? I’ll help you with whatever you need help with.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我之前说过吧？你需要什么帮助我都会帮。

lines.en: : I know, I know...It’s just really embarrassing.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道……只是太丢人了。

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux15
: Like...if it’s not good enough, I'm worried you’ll think I’m a loser and...want to give up on me or something.
lines.zh: : 比如……要是写得不够好，我怕您会觉得我是个废物，然后……想放弃我什么的。

lines.en: : Futaba, you’re one of the brightest girls I know.
lines.zh: : Futaba，你是我认识的最聪明的女孩之一。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: : Plus, aren’t we supposed to be friends now? Or were you not paying attention in class when I said that?
lines.zh: : 再说了，我们现在不是朋友了吗？还是我说那句话的时候你上课没在听？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux17
: I was definitely paying attention!
lines.zh: : 我绝对有在听！

lines.en: : I’m just still getting used to thinking of you as more than my teacher...
lines.zh: : 我只是还没习惯把您当成老师以外的人……

lines.en: : Up until recently, I...had no idea a friendship with you was even possible...
lines.zh: : 直到不久前，我……根本不知道跟您做朋友是可能的……

lines.en: : Is there...anything I can do to make the process a little easier?
lines.zh: : 有什么……我能做的，能让这个过程稍微容易一点吗？

lines.en: : To...make it easier?
lines.zh: : 让……更容易？

lines.en: : Yeah. Like something {i}friends{/i} would do, but not a teacher and a student?
lines.zh: : 嗯。像{i}朋友{/i}之间会做的事，但不是老师和学生之间会做的？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux13
: Not...anything that wouldn't make me sound really weird for suggesting it...
lines.zh: : 不是……不会让我说出来显得很奇怪的事……

lines.en: : Well, that certainly sounded suggestive. Are you flirting with me, Futaba?
lines.zh: : 嗯，这话听起来可真有暗示性。你在跟我调情吗，Futaba？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux17
: N-N-N-N-No! I would never suggest anything like that with you, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 不、不、不、不是！我绝对不敢对您提出那种事，Sensei！

lines.en: : Well, that just hurts.
lines.zh: : 哎，这话可真伤人。

lines.en: : Not that I don't find you attractive! I do! It's just that I respect you as a teacher and would never want to jeopardize our relationship and...uhh...
lines.zh: : 不是说我您不吸引人！您很有魅力！只是我尊敬您这位老师，绝不想拿我们的关系冒险，而且……呃……

lines.en: : Uhhh!
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃！

lines.en: : Deep breaths, Futaba. Now, what were you going to suggest we do in a completely platonic, non-flirtatious manner that will still somehow make you sound weird?
lines.zh: : 深呼吸，Futaba。那么，你本来想建议我们做一件完全柏拉图式、毫无调情意味、却还是会让你听起来很奇怪的事，是什么？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux13
: Just that...we maybe...I don't know...{i}hug{/i} or something?
lines.zh: : 就是……我们也许……我不知道……{i}抱一下{/i}什么的？

lines.en: : Oh. Easy.
lines.zh: : 哦。简单。

lines.en: scene futabahug1
: Ah! Sensei! W-W-W-what are you doing?
lines.zh: : 啊！Sensei！您、您、您在做什么？

lines.en: : You literally just suggested this.
lines.zh: : 这明明是你刚刚提议的。

lines.en: : I didn't think you'd just grab me! I didn't even have time to prepare!
lines.zh: : 我没想到您会直接抱上来！我连准备的时间都没有！

lines.en: : How do you prepare for a hug?...
lines.zh: : 拥抱要怎么准备啊？……

lines.en: : I have no idea! My mind is going a million miles an hour right now.
lines.zh: : 我不知道！我现在脑子转得快得要命。

lines.en: : And I...I think something hard is pushing up against me?
lines.zh: : 而且我……我觉得有什么硬硬的东西顶着我？

lines.en: : That’s just the feeling of my desire for you to succeed.
lines.zh: : 那只是我对你成功的渴望所化成的感觉。

lines.en: scene futabahug2
: Your {i}what?{/i}
lines.zh: : 您的{i}什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Nevermind that. The point is, we're friends now and, according to you, friends hug each other.
lines.zh: : 别管那个。重点是，我们现在是朋友了，而按你的说法，朋友之间会互相拥抱。

lines.en: : I don't really have any friends, so this is news to me.
lines.zh: : 我其实没什么朋友，所以这对我来说是新闻。

lines.en: : Please don't just casually say super depressing things like that. They'll confuse me even more.
lines.zh: : 求您别这么随口说出特别丧的话了。这会让我更混乱的。

lines.en: : You're going to have to get used to that side of me, Futaba. It is never going away.
lines.zh: : 你得习惯我这一面，Futaba。它永远不会消失。

lines.en: : This is...all happening so fast.
lines.zh: : 这一切……发生得太快了。

lines.en: : I guess. But hey, you're not trying to pull away, so I must be doing something right.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过嘿，你也没想挣开，所以我肯定做对了点什么。

lines.en: scene futabahug3
: Well...That’s just...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那只是……

lines.en: : Just what?
lines.zh: : 只是什么？

lines.en: scene futabahug4
: Ugh...you’re right. I honestly like this a lot...
lines.zh: : 唔……您说得对。说实话我真的很喜欢这样……

lines.en: : I knew it. You {i}were{/i} flirting with me.
lines.zh: : 我就知道。你{i}在{/i}跟我调情。

lines.en: scene futabahug5
: No...I just like hugs.
lines.zh: : 不是……我只是喜欢抱抱。

lines.en: : And I...
lines.zh: : 而且我……

lines.en: : I also...
lines.zh: : 我也……

lines.en: : I also like-
lines.zh: : 我也喜欢——

lines.en: scene futabahug7
: Ah-
: Sorry. I should take this.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我得接一下。

lines.en: scene black
: Hello?
: Hi, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 嗨，Sensei！

lines.en: : Hey. Did you need something?
lines.zh: : 嘿。有什么事吗？

lines.en: : Hm? No. Not really.
lines.zh: : 嗯？没有。其实没什么。
: 那个……

lines.en: : So what?
lines.zh: : 那个什么？

lines.en: : {i}So why did you call?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那你为什么打电话？{/i}

lines.en: : Oh!
: I just suddenly felt like you were about to do something that would make me sad. So I figured I'd let you hear my voice so you can remember I exist.
lines.zh: : 我只是突然觉得，你好像要做一件会让我难过的事。所以我想让你听听我的声音，好让你记得我存在。

lines.en: : Sensei? Are you still there?
lines.zh: : Sensei？您还在吗？

lines.en: : I'll talk to you later, Ami.
lines.zh: : 我晚点再跟你说，Ami。

lines.en: : Wait! Don't-
lines.zh: : 等等！别——

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux9
: Sorry about that. It was just Ami being overbearing again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是 Ami 又管得太宽了。

lines.en: : She...really likes you, doesn't she?
lines.zh: : 她……真的很喜欢您，对吧？

lines.en: : Yeah, well...I'm kind of all she has, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，怎么说呢……我算是她唯一的依靠了，所以……

lines.en: : Anyway, should we get back to the hugging now?
lines.zh: : 总之，我们要继续抱吗？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux13
: Oh, umm...I think we've...done enough of that for today...
lines.zh: : 啊，嗯……我觉得今天……已经抱得够多了……

lines.en: : I was actually just...thinking that I should probably...keep writing that story you asked me to write, so...
lines.zh: : 其实我刚才……在想我大概该……继续写您让我写的那个故事了，所以……

lines.en: : So you're kicking me out?
lines.zh: : 所以你是在赶我走？

lines.en: scene futabafirstdormredux9
: Can we think of it as me...politely asking you to leave?...
lines.zh: : 能不能把它理解成我……礼貌地请您离开？……

lines.en: : I guess we can.
lines.zh: : 大概可以吧。

lines.en: : But this is not the last you have hugged of me, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 但这不会是你最后一次抱我，Futaba。

lines.en: : Now, goodbye.
lines.zh: : 那么，再见。

lines.en: scene black
I exit the room in dramatic fashion, leaving Futaba dumbfounded and impressed by my above average way with words.
lines.zh: 我以戏剧性的方式走出房间，留下 Futaba 目瞪口呆，被我高于平均水平的措辞所折服。

lines.en: On my way down the stairs, I silently curse at Ami to myself for ruining what could have been a huge step for Futaba and me.
lines.zh: 下楼的时候，我在心里默默咒骂 Ami 毁掉了本可能属于我和 Futaba 的一大步。

lines.en: But I immediately forgive her upon returning home and finding dinner waiting for me.
lines.zh: 可一回到家、看到晚饭已经摆好，我立刻就原谅她了。

lines.en: $ futaba_love += 1
$ futabafirstvisit = True
{i}Futaba’s affection has increased to [futaba_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Futaba 的好感度提升到了 [futaba_love]!{/i}

lines.en: {i}You can now spend time with her in her room!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你现在可以和她在她的房间里共度时光了！{/i}
